title: Tank fill/drain batch cycle (level-driven state machine)
nl_spec: A batch tank runs a fill/drain cycle as a state machine with three states: 0 = Idle, 1 = Filling, 2 = Draining. From Idle, pressing StartCycle begins Filling (inlet Pump on) ONLY if the tank is not already at/above the high level (HIGH = 90%). In Filling, when the level reaches HIGH, switch to Draining (Pump off, outlet Valve on). In Draining, when the level falls to/below the low level (LOW = 10%), return to Idle. The emergency stop EStop is normally-closed (TRUE = healthy, FALSE = activated) and forces Idle with everything off. SAFETY: the pump and valve must never both be on; the pump must never run at/above HIGH; the valve must never be open at/below LOW. Use an internal INT State (0..2). Write an IEC 61131-3 Structured Text PROGRAM named tank_cycle with inputs Level, StartCycle, EStop and outputs Pump, Valve.

interface.name: EStop
interface.description: Emergency stop, normally-closed: TRUE = healthy, FALSE = activated

safety_properties.nl: The pump and valve are never both energized.
On emergency stop, the pump and valve are both off.
The inlet pump never runs at or above the high level.
The outlet valve is never open at or below the low level.

scenarios.description: Start with an already-full tank stays idle

notes: Analog-level-driven state machine (no timer). Start gated on Level<HIGH to avoid filling an already-full tank (else P3 would fail on entry).
